resources.string: Convert JPG to HEIC by Ray
Only keep the HEIC if it is smaller
Shrink oversized photos to fit the encoder
Keep the video (save as a HEIC motion photo)
Convert to a still (discard the video)

Samsung motion photos keep their video: the still is re-encoded to HEIC and the original video is re-attached, so it still plays. A motion photo whose video can\'t be carried across is skipped rather than flattened. \"Only keep if smaller\" still applies.
Converts in memory to measure the real saving. Nothing is added to your gallery and no original is deleted.
Finds JPGs in this range that already have a HEIC beside them — left behind by a run that was cancelled or whose delete prompt was declined.
